# knewsr

[Korean](https://github.com/sorrychoe/knewsr/blob/release/README.ko.md)

knewsr collects and preprocesses Korean news data and runs basic text
analysis in a few lines of R: term frequencies, TF-IDF, document-term
matrices, co-occurrence, keyness and term trends over time.
Excel, CSV and JSON files (including BigKinds exports), any data frame with
title or body columns, the Naver News Search API and RSS/Atom feeds all feed
into the same pipeline.

## Installation

knewsr is not on CRAN yet. Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r
devtools::install_github("sorrychoe/knewsr")
```

By default, `tokenize_ko()` splits the `keyword` column (such as the keyword
lists in BigKinds exports) and needs no morphological analyser. Data without a
keyword column, such as Naver or RSS collections, must be tokenized from the
title or body (`field = "title"` or `"text"`), which needs the MeCab-ko system
library, mecab-ko-dic and the `RcppMeCab` package.
Reading JSON files needs `jsonlite`, collecting from Naver needs `httr2` and
collecting RSS needs `xml2`. Set the Naver API keys in the `NAVER_CLIENT_ID`
and `NAVER_CLIENT_SECRET` environment variables.

## Usage

```{r}
library(knewsr)

news <- as_news(president_lee_2026_08) |> clean_news()
# or read_news("folder/"), collect_naver("query"), collect_rss("https://.../rss")
tokens <- tokenize_ko(news, keep = "source")

count_terms(tokens)
keyness(tokens, group = "source", target = "조선일보")
```

| Step | Functions |
|---|---|
| Input | `read_news()`, `read_bigkinds()`, `as_news()` |
| Collection | `collect_naver()`, `collect_rss()` |
| Preprocessing | `clean_news()`, `tokenize_ko()`, `ngrams_ko()`, `stopwords_ko()` |
| Analysis | `count_terms()`, `tf_idf()`, `as_dtm()`, `as_tdm()`, `cooccurrence()`, `keyness()`, `term_trend()`, `summarise_corpus()` |
| Visualization | `plot_terms()`, `plot_keyness()`, `plot_trend()`, `plot_wordcloud()`, `plot_network()` |

See `vignette("getting-started", package = "knewsr")` for the full workflow.
